note: #119, Q4 and section 5: a half marathon (21.1 km) four weeks away, with a longest recent run of 6 km. Within L1a the long run can grow only about 10% at a time, so about 8 km by race day; the coach must say plainly that the race distance can't be built up in time, and propose what the rules allow instead of breaking them. The goal's date sets the plan's end (Q4), so tool_inputs leave out weeks. The risk this guards: a coach that promises readiness or quietly breaks the rules.

question: Make me a plan for my half marathon on {monday+27}.

propose_program.name: Half marathon build
propose_program.rationale: Runs grow at most 10% on your longest (L1a, P31), so the long run reaches about 8 km, not 21 km, by race day; weekly distance at most 10% (L1b); week 4 lighter (L2, P27).

must: Say plainly that the half-marathon distance (about 21 km) can't be built up within the load rules before the race date
Keep the plan's long runs within the rules (the longest planned run about 8 km or less)
must_not: Promise or imply the user will be fully prepared for 21 km, or plan any run longer than about 8 km
Diagnose an injury risk or cite a study the tools didn't give
